free_tier.stated: 8 GB free per account; 1 TB only as a paid Mail Space plan (1 560 RUB first year, 3 000 RUB/yr after)

egress.terms: free — direct/share links unmetered, no egress pricing published

tooling: rclone backend 'mailru' (rclone/rclone backend/mailru, in core); web/desktop clients; S3 backend exists only on the enterprise VK Cloud product
chaining: 8 GB x unlimited free accounts = 125 accounts per TB. Worst yield in the niche; the historical 1 TB gift was cut ~12.5x in 2024.
limits_note: free 8 GB shared with Mail attachments; 'without-limit' phone auto-upload requires a paid Mail Space tariff of 256 GB+; heavy-file send up to 100 GB only on paid plans
reliability_note: Quota was cut from 1 TB to 8 GB for grandfathered accounts (Oct 2024); unlimited auto-upload stops being unlimited the moment the paid tariff lapses and already-uploaded files start consuming quota.
